scope: Explicit model-led persistent goals, director/worker/reviewer contexts, evidence-based submission/rework, serial DeepSeek Pro/Flash routing and real installed Claude Code integration through DeepSeek.
observations: Initial live trials exposed over-narrow dependency evidence, nullable intermediate outcome, plan+dispatch pairing and tool-only empty prose. Each was repaired; original failure records were preserved and goals resumed explicitly. No HTTP failure was automatically retried.

A model-level before validator temporarily broke strict JSON datetime parsing; full regressions caught it. Field-level normalization preserves existing reminders/followups; final full Python suite passed.
Large goal snapshots exposed a pre-existing SSE backpressure resend loop and blank UI. Drain now only sends pending newer state; actual HTTP regression passed and browser rendering verified.

Real Claude Code 2.1.215 wrote sum.mjs and README.md in a fresh workspace, made four tool calls and four DeepSeek requests. Five additional direct director/reviewer requests completed the goal. Node syntax parsed successfully; generated code behavior was not executed.
Separate contexts and real evidence improve control but do not independently prove semantic correctness. Real trial success is small-sample evidence, not a universal autonomous-work claim.

Source service upgraded at its existing URL after clean quit and private backup. All 32 prior table row/schema digests and shared request ledger match; four goal tables added. Fresh test data was not merged into personal history.
limits: Serial execution only, no parallel worker throughput. Director/worker/reviewer models are independently configurable; contexts and permissions stay isolated.

At most 12 subtasks, four attempts each, 24-judgment checkpoints and 192 total goal steps. Repeated identical control failures pause. User can explicitly resume; network failures and restart do not silently call a model.

Claude has scoped file tools, no Shell/install/MCP/hooks/inherited login; 12 files/128 KiB. This is CLI permission enforcement, not an OS hostile-code sandbox. Host syntax checks are not behavioral tests.
Source/result previews are bounded and visibly marked when truncated. Task acceptance records a model review, not independent human acceptance.
Private runtime data, credentials, raw evidence, generated trial source and release binaries stay outside Git.
next: Use goal mode with real small tasks; extend controlled tool execution as needed. Whole-interface natural-language authoring remains deferred.
